TITLE: Music
DESCRIPTION: Playback from YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud and direct sources
FILTER_HINT: Takes effect from the next track.

DASHBOARD.SUBTITLE: What is playing and what comes next
DASHBOARD.NOTHING_HINT: Start with /play in Discord — then you can control it from here.
DASHBOARD.BOT_WEG_HINT: Without the bot I cannot tell what is playing. Controls stay empty until it is back.

ADD.TITLE: Add something
ADD.HINT: The bot must already be in a voice channel — it cannot join one from the dashboard.
ADD.SUGGEST_HINT: Typing shows suggestions — picking one uses exactly that track.

QUEUE.SUBTITLE: What is still to come, reorder or remove
QUEUE.EMPTY_HINT: Add something and it shows up here.
QUEUE.ONLY_CURRENT: Nothing after this one — add something to keep it going.

PLAYLISTS.SUBTITLE: Saved lists for recurring evenings
PLAYLISTS.NAME: Name
PLAYLISTS.EMPTY_HINT: A playlist holds resolved tracks — no searching needed when it plays.
PLAYLISTS.ADD_CURRENT: Add current track to a playlist

HISTORY.SUBTITLE: What was actually played
HISTORY.EMPTY_HINT: Once something plays, it appears here.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Music settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Who may control it, which sources are allowed, and how it plays
SETTINGS.DJ_ROLE_HELP: Without this role nobody can skip or stop. Anyone alone with the bot may still control it.
SETTINGS.VOTE_SKIP_HELP: Lets everyone in the channel skip together, even without the DJ role.
SETTINGS.SPOTIFY_MISSING: Spotify links are not set up — for everything else you need to do nothing. Search, YouTube and SoundCloud links work without credentials. Only pasting a spotify.com link (track, album, your own playlist) needs SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET in apps/bot/.env.
SETTINGS.SPOTIFY_NOTE: Spotify serves no audio through its API, only title and artist. The bot then searches YouTube — this is how all known music bots work.
SETTINGS.MODE247_HELP: The bot stays in the voice channel even when nothing plays and nobody is there.
SETTINGS.AUTOPLAY_HELP: When the queue runs empty, the bot looks for matching tracks.
SETTINGS.ANNOUNCE_SAME: Same channel the command came from
SETTINGS.LEAVE_EMPTY: Leave channel when nobody is left

JS.EINGABE_FEHLT: Enter a URL or search term.
JS.TITEL_ENTFERNEN: Remove this track from the playlist?
JS.STOPPEN_FRAGE: Stop playback and clear the queue?
